rayquaza: Retreat into Mega Kangaskhan to draw 2 when nothing can attack and retreat is free (kgPivot); promote it first when Latias is in play (kgLead).
Value Latias before the bench attacker is ready when the active is a heavy non-attacker (ltAhead).
Use Judge when the active is stranded and no Latias/Hyper Ball/Cyano route exists (judgeStuck).
zoroark: Keep Mochi only when +40 is the knockout line for a planned target (board or known incoming attacker of the opponent deck type); otherwise it may be a Trade cost (mochiNeed).
Play the cards already planned this turn (bench, energy, tool) before Lillie's Determination shuffles the hand.
rejected: Not benching extra Meowth ex; gating Cyano by missing roles (no measurable gain in 2,000 games).
